summary: Unidentified woman (+19493542093) who contacted Derrek for help with multiple banned/disabled Instagram accounts. She sent screenshots of the ban reasons for at least two accounts; Derrek explained she had never filed an appeal on the first one and that Meta's AI now auto-flags multiple accounts sharing a device, IP, email, or phone number. He advised her to keep only one personal and one business account, warned that registering a business account requires real business info, and confirmed she can keep a page for her tattoo work (he did not think the drawn nude-style tattoo art triggered the ban, since that would show as a sexual-content ban). Conversation ended at the advisory stage — no price quoted, no recovery work started, so she is a warm lead for a paid unban/recovery.
key_facts: Multiple Instagram accounts banned/disabled; at least 2 discussed
First account never had an appeal submitted — appeal path may still be open
Second account's ban notice suggests it was flagged for creating additional accounts on the same device/IP/email/phone
